title: New Archaeological Evidence for an Early Human Presence at Monte Verde, Chile (Dillehay and others, 2015)

source.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the PDF; the PLoS ONE page links the 4.0 deed)

summary: Presents new archaeological evidence for an early human presence at Monte Verde in Chile, in the long debate over when and how people first reached the Americas. Context for the world lane on who was where.

tool.name: PageIndex
tool.method: PageIndex Flash mode run through Claude Code (claude-code/haiku; doc_id pi-9165e485de694c1d969cdea12d716d36; store in out/pageindex). The tree follows the paper's own headings. I replaced PageIndex's model-written summaries, which contained numbers I could not stand behind, with short summaries of what each section covers, and tidied titles. Text is the PDF text layer by page.
